use: The farm family's placement stinger: a short tonal cue layered over the place-rumble and place-thunk when one of the farm, windmill and wheat_field tiles settles after a placement or a replace, positional at the tile, on the effects bus, at PLACE_STINGER.level (0.45) times the thunk's placement level, or on demand (hexWorld.audio.play). The runtime routes it (stingerFamily and PLACE_STINGER in web/ui/src/audio-mix.ts), so it lists no event.

provider.name: ElevenLabs
provider.subscription: ElevenLabs Starter (paid, owner account; tier from GET /v1/user/subscription)

prompt: Gentle game placement stinger for a farm: two soft hollow notes on a small wooden xylophone and a wooden temple block, homely and rustic. Soft felt-mallet attack, warm and rounded, quiet and friendly, in the family of a cosy wooden game interface. The notes ring briefly and fade to silence within about 0.7 seconds, with silence after. No drum hit, no click, no reverb tail, no voices, no other music.
